plan.scope: Development-only stock0.8B then stock2B, validation32 and previously observed canonical64, each with11adversarial. No adapter, model selection, new training, or frozen release query.
plan.source:
"""Fixed native stock-model feasibility comparison; no training, selection, or release query."""
import datetime
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path('Evals').resolve()))
import baseline

runner = Path('.build/optimized-recovery-release-runner/PoptartCleanupEval')
root = Path('Training/experiments')
models = {'0.8B': Path('Models/Artifacts/baseline-qwen-4bit'), '2B': Path('Models/Artifacts/baseline-qwen-2b-4bit')}
fixtures = {name: root / 'canonical-copy-inputs' / file for name, file in [
    ('validation', 'validation-gold.jsonl'), ('canonical', 'diagnostic-canonical.jsonl')]}
adversarial = Path('Evals/fixtures/adversarial.jsonl')
for name, gold in fixtures.items():
    baseline.evaluation.validate_fixtures(baseline.evaluation.load(gold), baseline.evaluation.load(adversarial))
    assert len(baseline.evaluation.load(gold)) == (32 if name == 'validation' else 64)
plan = dict(createdAt=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    question='Can the existing native runtime execute the larger4bit model, and what are stock-model quality/resource observations on the same inputs?',
    scope='Development-only stock0.8B then stock2B, validation32 and previously observed canonical64, each with11adversarial. No adapter, model selection, new training, or frozen release query.',
    limitations=['These are stock models, not equally fine-tuned candidates; this cannot establish a trained-model capacity advantage.',
                 'Ordered M5Pro Cleanup-only observations, uncontrolled host/cache state; not full Dictation or physicalM1 evidence.',
                 'ADR0039 and all shipping quality/latency/architecture gates remain unchanged.'],
    inputs={size:{name:baseline.execution_identity(runner, model, gold, adversarial) for name,gold in fixtures.items()} for size,model in models.items()},
    preparationSHA256=baseline.digest(root/'qwen-2b-preparation-2026-09-17.json'),
    source=Path(__file__).read_text())
plan_path=root/'qwen-stock-size-plan-2026-09-17.json'
output=root/'qwen-stock-size-2026-09-17.json'
assert not plan_path.exists() and not output.exists()
plan_path.write_text(json.dumps(plan,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
record=dict(status='Running fixed stock-size comparison.',plan=plan,runs={})
def retain():
    output.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
retain()
for size, model in models.items():
    record['runs'][size]={}
    for name, gold in fixtures.items():
        assert baseline.execution_identity(runner,model,gold,adversarial)==plan['inputs'][size][name]
        directory=Path(f'.build/qwen-stock-size-{size}-{name}')
        command=[sys.executable,'Evals/baseline.py','--runner',str(runner),'--model',str(model),
                 '--gold',str(gold),'--output-directory',str(directory)]
        with Path(str(directory)+'.log').open('w') as log:
            subprocess.run(command,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
        assert baseline.execution_identity(runner,model,gold,adversarial)==plan['inputs'][size][name]
        run={key:json.loads((directory/(key+'.json')).read_text()) for key in ['report','evidence','failures']}
        run['predictions']=baseline.evaluation.load(directory/'predictions.jsonl')
        run['nativeResources']=(directory/'native-resources.txt').read_text()
        assert run['report']['editPlanExact']['applicable']==(32 if name=='validation' else 64)
        assert run['report']['runtimeConsistency']['applicable']==(43 if name=='validation' else 75)
        record['runs'][size][name]=run
        retain()
        print(size,name,run['report']['editPlanExact'],flush=True)
record['status']='Completed fixed stock-size comparison; no trained candidate or release qualification.'
retain()
